evidence.side_effect: the Firefox measurement command received the server-log hash instead of its own log hash

resolution.change: Locate the pending profile-server command record by command identity during finalization and update that record rather than indexing the final command in the expanded list.

root_cause: The path correction retained the right server log but finalization still wrote its hash through self.commands[-1]. Ten browser commands had been appended since startup, leaving the actual server record pending and corrupting the final browser command hash.
